limitations: These are published model-based OECD GHG estimates using residence-based environmental accounts, not territorial inventories, facility measurements or the physical transport of carbon.
Total production and demand footprints include direct household emissions. Industry-only and household components are retained separately. They are not plant-level or ownership-attributed footprints.

Gross trade emissions can count emissions again when intermediates cross borders repeatedly. Foreign-origin emissions allocated to final demand are a different measure and must not be substituted for gross imports.

The primary comparison has 80 named economies and a rest-of-world account. Overlapping OECD/world/regional aggregates are retained as references, not added to the country map or bilateral allocation edges.

The source edition is 2025, acquired 30 October 2026; its SDMX constraints carry 2026 revision dates. Source values are often rounded to 0.001 million tonnes. A published zero may reflect rounding; no missing values or confidence intervals are invented.

National emissions, country-industry value added and employee compensation do not identify who receives household income, who controls a particular commodity shipment, or who experiences pollution exposure or health harm.

The retained EPA facility series use their own boundaries and CO2-equivalence conventions. They are not added to these national footprints or automatically used to allocate global footprints to Virginia.

Current-dollar monetary comparisons are not inflation- or purchasing-power-adjusted. National IOT employee components and global ICIO value added are separate harmonized sources and are not forced to reconcile.
A comparison of policies with footprints or trade is descriptive unless a separate causal study design is implemented. Policy is not automatically converted to a final-demand shock.

limitations: Different source populations and geographic boundaries remain separate.
No facility output, traded quantity, emissions, pollution or economic value is allocated to an owner or a trade link.
Regional inventory points are context, not suppliers/customers or proof that a mapped shipment visited a site.
Source roles include operator, controller, owner, owner-or-operator and accounting parent; none is silently converted to verified ultimate beneficial control.
Environmental observations are annual reports, not exposure, toxicity, health effects or a complete life-cycle footprint.
No nearest source year, interpolated ownership transaction, inferred route or name/proximity match is used.

other_source_inventories.scope: Dated source country policy/context, source-notifiedagreement/restriction records, national trade values; no legal applicability or causal trade effect.

other_source_inventories.title: U.S. counties and county equivalents · Census 2025
limitations: These generalized 2025 county boundaries are for thematic display, not legal boundary surveys or area/production calculations.

A historical source FIPS code is mapped only when its literal 5 digit identifier exists. Historic codes, obsolete counties and special aggregatecodes remain unassigned; no redistribution or guessed crosswalk is performed.
Current county identities do not reconstruct historical borders. Same-code boundary changes can affect time comparisons.
Connecticut 2025 features are its 9 planning-region county equivalents. Old 8 county codes must not be silently assigned to them.
Virginia independent cities remain separate county equivalents. Puerto Rico and island-area units are retained separately from the 50 states/DC population.

NAD83 coordinates were explicitly transformed to WGS84 using available PROJ operations. Some island-area/edge coordinates have only a ballpark geographic offset available; positional precision is not inferred from numeric digits.
All source polygon rings/topology are retained; ring orientation is normalized only. Any invalid generalized source topology is retained and reported, not silently repaired.
Rendering may omit native shapes outside a chosen projection; data rows must remain in tables and counts.

access_note: Original source identities and publisher references are retained. The complete original built-in numerical records are publicly available through /full-data/index.json; the additive historical collections and original-response archives are registered in /data/historical-resources-manifest.json. Private/imported tables and participant records remain excluded. Source definitions, editions and publisher terms stay attached.
